A '''duel''' occurred on a [[Commerce Guild trading station]] between [[Minch (Jedi)|Minch]] and an [[Unidentified Bpfasshi Dark Jedi|unidentified]] [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. Minch lost the duel, and when another [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] came to help Minch, the Bpfasshi killed him.
